name: AI Content Cleanup
description: Admin dashboard that scans node text fields for markup issues (broken HTML, inline styles, heading jumps, missing alt, empty/deprecated tags) and rewrites them in place with regex/DOM rules.
project_description: AI Content Cleanup provides an admin dashboard (under Content → AI Content Cleanup) for detecting and fixing common markup problems in migrated and legacy node content: broken/unbalanced HTML, inline styles, skipped heading levels, images missing alt text, empty layout elements, and deprecated presentational tags. A scan walks the configured node bundles, records detected issues in two custom database tables, and shows them across dashboard, scan, results, editor, bulk, reports, templates and history pages. The side-by-side editor previews an original-vs-cleaned diff and can apply the cleaned markup back to a node as a new revision. Despite the name, this release performs the cleanup with deterministic regular-expression and DOMDocument transformations — it does not call an LLM or the drupal/ai module. Two permissions gate it: a read permission for dashboards/scans/reports and a restricted admin permission for the editor, bulk operations, templates and applying fixes.
